Hmm, `use_machine` is set True but the modules were created... let me look at build_case: `modules` are created in a loop that checks `if machine is not None:` for adding st/msg params — but `machine` is None at that point (it's assigned later). I need to use `use_machine` there too.

Let me patch all the `if machine is not None:` occurrences inside build_case to `if use_machine:`.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='fuzz.py'; t=open(p).read()
start = t.index('def build_case(')
end = t.index('def encode_run(')
body = t[start:end]
body = body.replace('''        if machine is not None:
            params.append(["st", "__STATE__"])''', '''        if use_machine:
            params.append(["st", "__STATE__"])''')
body = body.replace('''        if machine is not None:
            # the state and message parameters are required''', '''        if use_machine:
            # the state and message parameters are required''')
t = t[:start] + body + t[end:]
t = t.replace('''    if machine is not None:
        # every entry parameter used by a filter binding must exist
        pass''', '')
open(p,'w').write(t)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && grep -n "use_machine\|machine is not None" fuzz.py | head -20
